items.question: Under what condition can one whose mind is fixed on that remain uncut even when being cut?
premises: Cutting is being directed at one who is in process of being cut.
A mind fixed on that remains oriented away from the act of cutting.
That orientation prevents the act of cutting from taking effect.
items.inference: One whose mind is fixed on that is not cut, just as a particular state prevents severance.
uncertainties: The precise referent of tad and tan remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that is not cut even while being cut, so too severance does not take effect in that state.
